text:
ana_cs: FYI CedarPoint Health signed for a Private instance. They want to onboard a multilingual discharge-summary redactor to remove PHI before storage. Uploaded bundle + evals to their bucket.
tom_eng: drop the bucket path + model details? format matters for runtime.
nana_cs: s3://cedarpoint-onboarding/redactor-v1.zip. Inside: redactor.onnx, labels.json, vocab/*.spm. Model ~6.8B equiv, converted to ONNX with dynamic axes. License: custom permissive, but they own the training data (PHI).
jeff_research: good. Ask them for the redaction spec: what entity types must be removed? Also desired recall vs precision tradeoff.
mana_cs: They require recall > 99.5 for direct identifiers, high recall for dates/ids, and prefer over-redaction rather than leaks. Also want confidence score thresholds and a manual-override webhook.
mike_sre: audit & compliance notes: Private deployment must ship with KMS + HSM support, tokenized audit trail, and daily key rotation policy. Network peering and strict egress rules too.
tom_eng: ONNX is fine. We should validate dynamic batching behavior for longer summaries. Canary suggestion: 500 requests/day, p95 < 400ms on a T4x2 equivalent for typical 512-token inputs.
deploy-bot: Checklist created: /deploys/cedarpoint-redactor-1736001111 (INFRA-9456).
jeff_research: for safety evals propose three suites: redaction recall test (entity-level), over-redaction analysis (utility loss), and adversarial PI probing (clever prompts). Proposed pass: direct-id recall >= 99.5%, overall utility loss < 8%.
mana_cs: CedarPoint asked explicitly for per-field recall logs and exportable CSVs for audits. They will withhold final payment if audit exports are missing at go-live. Renewal risk flagged if we miss export SLA.
mike_sre: will need their KMS ARN and the subnets for peering. Also confirm whether they want local HSM or cloud HSM.
tom_eng: we may try quantizing ONNX to int8 but need to run a sensitivity sweep; redaction recall must not drop. If quant harms recall, we'll keep fp16.
jeff_research: please upload a small set (50 examples) of realistic discharge notes for offline eval. We will delete after testing per DPA.
mana_cs: sample notes are at s3://cedarpoint-onboarding/examples/50_samples.txt (they redacted a few already). Also included docs/redaction-spec.md and webhooks/example_override.json.
legal_olivia: tagging me for DPA addendum review. I'll run through clauses and suggest logging language and deletion windows. Need to see the SOW in the bucket.
nana_cs: SOW is at s3://cedarpoint-onboarding/SOW.pdf.
mike_sre: INFRA ticket opened for peering + KMS: INFRA-9456 created by mike_sre.
tom_eng: enablement: CedarPoint requested a 60-minute walkthrough focused on override webhooks, audit exports, and retrain hooks. They prefer Wed 10am ET next week.
nana_cs: confirmed Wed 10am ET works for them. I'll send calendar invite and include runbook link.
jeff_research: timeline: I'll run the eval harness on staging and post results in ~4 business days. If recall passes, we'll schedule canary rollout.
mike_sre: note on metrics: please instrument per-field recall, false-redaction rate, avg tokens removed, and audit export latency.
legal_olivia: will have DPA comments by EOD +2.
nana_cs: thanks all — updating CedarPoint after legal signoff. :white_check_mark:
